_about: Proposed ground truth for the external violations (data/external_violations.csv), written by reading each article against code_of_conduct/code_of_conduct.json. Every article is labelled a violation in the spreadsheet, and that label is kept. The spreadsheet's clause (e.g. 6.1) is mapped to the matching sub-rule; rules not in the given clause are marked given=false, and rules I'm not sure of best_guess=true. proposal: violation (rule clear) | best_guess (rule is my best guess) | rule_unknown (no rule found) | bad_data (the text isn't the article). All 28 were confirmed (violations.external_review); their rules and highlights are the ground truth in violations.manual_annotations.
